name: GBA Voxel Slice Heightmap Renderer
definition: A software rendering technique for 3D voxel terrain on constrained hardware that iterates over discrete depth/height slices (steps), maps screen columns to world coordinates using precomputed lookup tables and fixed-point math, samples a heightmap, and draws vertical lines to a frame buffer while maintaining a per-column height buffer for occlusion.
summary: A GBA voxel renderer that iterates depth slices, uses precomputed lookup tables for fixed-point coordinate mapping, and draws occlusion-aware vertical lines to optimize terrain rendering on constrained hardware.
